name: Ring of Animal Influence

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Fear
powers.text: Fear, only against Beasts with Intelligence 3 or lower.

summary: 3 charges: Animal Friendship, Fear (Beasts only) or Speak with Animals (save DC 13).
text: This ring has 3 charges, and it regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. While wearing the ring, you can expend 1 of its charges to cast one of the following spells (save DC 13) from it: Animal Friendship, Fear (affecting only Beasts that have an Intelligence of 3 or lower), or Speak with Animals.
